Name: Remember Faced Direction
Author: Annosz
Description:
[size=5]Remember Faced Direction[/size]

In Stardew Valley certain actions make your farmer change his directions. This includes things like:

[list]
[*]Eating
[*]Opening a treasure chest in the mines
[*]Finding a lost book
[*]Getting a tool upgrade at Clint
[/list]and many other things...

This mod solves this issue and turns the farmer back to it's original direction, so you can continue whatever you were doing.



[size=4]Requirements[/size]

This mod requires SMAPI.



[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

This mod has no known compatibility issues.



﻿[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

﻿[size=4]See also

[/size]See the source code on [url=https://github.com/Annosz/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/StardewValleyMods/RememberFacedDirection]Github[/url]﻿.
